description: Start a weather-records lookup for one U.S. street address and date.  Returns a lookup_id; the records are ready in about two minutes -- call get_lookup with it.  Records reach back to about 1960.  Records, not opinions: nothing returned is a determination about any property.  Each accepted lookup uses one of the key's 10 free lookups this month.

address.description: Full U.S. street address with city, state and ZIP, e.g. 123 Main St, Nashville, TN 37203
